title: Farm command palette request (v2) shared definitions
description: Shared $defs for the Farm command palette (Milkshake Story 10.3, docs/farm-commands.md section 14): the v2 signed request the portal Worker signs and farm-command-bridge wraps, and the data shape of the three billing.farm_command.* result events. Each billing.<entity>.<verb> palette command schema refines palette_request with its subject, command and args; every shape here is the one 14.3.2 fixes for all three implementations. Patterns are anchored with ^...$ and the bridge checks the trailing-newline gap in code (rule 4).

slug.description: A Milkshake client or vendor slug (domain.model.SLUG).

day.description: A calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD. The pattern cannot say 2026-02-30 is not a date: validators do not assert format unless told to, so the bridge also checks it with date.fromisoformat (check_palette_request).

instant.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ: the Worker clock, milliseconds padded with 000.

email.description: A verified session email, trimmed and lowercased. At most 158 characters: the run actor farm:<email>/<command_id> is 5 + email + 1 + 36 characters and the ledger schemas cap data.actor at 200 (docs/farm-commands.md 14.3.1).

reason.description: 1 to 500 code points; the first and last character are not in the fixed WS set (U+0009 to U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000 to U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, U+FEFF). Control characters are refused by rule 4 in code.

flag.description: A CLI switch: true, or left out. Never false.

palette_request.description: The v2 request the portal Worker signed, exactly as signed (docs/farm-commands.md 14.3.1). args is left to the referencing command schema.

command_id.description: uuid5(NS_FARM_COMMAND, session_id + ":" + client_request_id); equals the envelope command_id.

client_request_id.description: A nonce the browser mints once per submit; a retry of the same submit reuses it.

subject.description: The entry's subject from the allow-list, set by the Worker.

command.description: An allow-list name with handler run.

client.description: The client the command acts for.

args.description: Only arguments that are set; refined by the referencing command schema.

session_id.description: The auth session row id, never the session token.

value.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON bytes of request.

palette_data.description: The command envelope data (docs/farm-commands.md 14.4.2): data.schema_version is this schema family's first revision, request.schema_version is the v2 request shape.

received_at.description: When the bridge accepted it; equals the envelope time.
